claims.statement: IV methylprednisolone 60 mg/d or hydrocortisone 100 mg TID-QID for 3-5 days is the standard; nonresponders need rescue therapy or surgery -- do not delay
claims.evidence_excerpt: ASUC defined as ≥6 bloody stools/day plus systemic toxicity (Truelove and Witts). Up to 25% of UC patients develop ASUC; 40% require colectomy.
